Home.title: Wire one tool to another, without the glue code.
Home.subtitle: Flowcore is a backend-heavy mini-Zapier you run yourself. Define event-driven automations declaratively — we handle ingestion, queuing, execution, retries, and per-step logging.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.body: Start a workflow from a unique webhook URL or a cron schedule.

steps.title: Steps
steps.body: Chain http, ai_summarize, slack_post, and jira_fetch. Output N feeds N+1.

executions.title: Executions
executions.body: Every run is queued, retried with backoff, and logged step by step.

BrandPanel.title: Wire any tool to any other.
BrandPanel.subtitle: Event-driven automations, defined declaratively. We handle the queue, retries, scheduling, and per-step logs — you describe the flow.
BrandPanel.footer: Self-hosted · multi-tenant · JWT auth · per-workspace isolation
